results.title: Astros fall as Phillies hammer Houston pitching in middle innings to overcome deficit
results.description: The Astros once again piled up runs against the Phillies but Houston's pitching staff couldn't make it hold up as Philadelphia got to starter Hunter Brown.

results.title: Photos of the NFL season opener, a rare Super Bowl rematch between the Seahawks and Patriots
results.description: SEATTLE (AP) — The NFL season opens with the Seattle Seahawks launching their title defense against the New England Patriots in a rare rematch of the previous season’s Super Bowl.
